title: Phase 3: usable workflows and six-user operational correctness

safety.paid_calls: forbidden: every command uses the fake provider; OPENAI_API_KEY and RFP_* variables are removed from every child environment
safety.data: fixtures and runtimes are created under the receipt directory; real-corpus checks require an isolated copy declared in the local settings and never the authoritative .runtime
safety.approval: the runner refuses to execute until verification.local.json approves this file's SHA-256 and the command IDs to run

local_settings.description: Owner-supplied and git-ignored. Run `python tools/verify.py approve-template` for a starting file; nothing in it is secret.

required.approval.approved_by: name of the person who inspected the commands below
required.approval.contract_sha256: SHA-256 of this verification.json as printed by `approve-template`; a changed contract needs a new approval
required.approval.commands: command IDs the owner allows the runner to execute

optional.python: interpreter for every command (default: the one running tools/verify.py)
optional.tiktoken_cache_dir: offline tokenizer cache passed to commands as TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR
optional.real_corpus.source_dir: isolated copy of the originals (absolute path)
optional.real_corpus.data_dir: isolated copy of the runtime database and index (absolute path, never the authoritative .runtime)
optional.real_corpus.isolated_copy: must be true: the owner confirms both directories are copies
optional.real_corpus.hwp_doc_id: parsed and indexed HWP document for real-corpus checks
optional.real_corpus.pdf_doc_id: parsed and indexed PDF document for real-corpus checks
optional.real_corpus.question: question that finds evidence in both documents
optional.browser: name, version and viewport used for manual steps; copied into the receipt

commands.purpose: whitespace gate on the working tree
phase 3 service, budget and request-state gate
six concurrent members against one temporary ledger
injected post-dispatch timeouts stay unknown and are never retried
native Ctrl+C (Windows CTRL_C_EVENT, POSIX SIGINT) stops a running request before its next paid stage
frozen verifier runs on the isolated real corpus generate from exactly their evidence and estimate
open visitor, role declarations, sealed rows
late answers, history and evidence panels
controlled stop, restart recovery, dispatch guard
provider interval reconciliation and owner settlement
single, comparison, metadata and inventory answers
managed downloads, evidence warnings, redacted exports
frozen runs, configurations, frozen generation, serving fallbacks

flows.title: Open access with attribution; role declarations hold at the service

manual.do: Open the app in two browsers with different typed names; visit every page.
manual.expect: No login form; every page opens; each request, review and audit event shows the typed name.

flows.title: Search, select, ask and open original evidence

manual.do: Search a long Korean title; select an HWP; ask; open table evidence; download the managed original.
manual.expect: Titles wrap; filters and historical notice show; evidence opens at the cited table; the download equals the original and keeps its Korean filename in a desktop browser.

manual.do: Switch to a PDF; open a citation on a late physical page; try an ambiguous code without scope and a quarantined source if one exists.
manual.expect: The late page opens with original content; the ambiguous code asks for scope; a quarantined source is refused without a paid call.

flows.title: Balanced comparison, metadata view and requirement inventory
contracts: phase3-plan#5. Complete deterministic modes and balanced comparisons

manual.do: Compare two selected RFPs; open basic information and the requirement list for each.
manual.expect: Both documents contribute facts or explicit limitations; unknown, 0원 and conflicting values stay distinct; the inventory states what it covers.

flows.title: Background requests, stale answers and history
contracts: phase3-plan#2. Move long paid execution out of UI reruns
phase3-plan#3. Give UI state explicit ownership

manual.do: With fake_delay_seconds set, ask, then change scope or question before the answer arrives; submit twice; reload; open the request from 내 최근 요청.
manual.expect: No stale answer attaches; one request and one attempt exist; history shows every request separately and its evidence opens on the first click; the attempt settles.

flows.title: Controlled stop and conservative restart
contracts: runbook#4. Request execution and controlled stop

flows.title: Six users share one cap; status stays live during calls

manual.do: In a second session start a delayed call; watch the first session's budget.
manual.expect: The first session's budget changes within the polling interval; reservation, settled and unknown cost are distinguished.

manual.do: Reach a temporary test cap; keep browsing, refresh and poll; try an admin action without a reason.
manual.expect: Generation blocks; free browsing works; refresh and polling create no attempts; the reasonless action is refused; every recorded action is in the audit log.

flows.title: Reconciliation, owner settlement and unknown attempts
contracts: phase3-plan#7. Execute budget reconciliation and recovery scenarios

flows.title: Frozen verifier runs, comparison, corrections and frozen generation
contracts: runbook#4. Request execution and controlled stop

manual.do: Make a single and a two-document verifier run (two documents with an evidence limit of 2); generate from each with the fake provider.
manual.expect: The form enforces at least two units for two documents; generation uses the run's evidence and date; the reservation is within the displayed maximum.

flows.title: Keyboard, focus, contrast and narrow layout

manual.do: Use only the keyboard through ask, evidence and history; check status labels, contrast and a narrow (390 px) viewport; save screenshots.
manual.expect: Every control is reachable with visible focus; states are labelled in text; content is readable without horizontal scrolling.
